notes: Social shelf — connect YouTube, X, Facebook, TikTok and Instagram right from the project dock. Signing in is an ordinary browser login in its own window (no API keys, OAuth apps or developer accounts), and each platform keeps a persistent profile so you stay signed in between launches. Once connected, a card can open that platform's own composer to post, or pull its live logged-in feed onto the canvas as a browser panel. Sign out wipes that platform's profile.
